events.title: Soft Start Seen For Hong Kong Stock Market
events.description: The Hong Kong stock market on Tuesday ended the two-day slide in which it had dropped more than 350 points or 1.4 percent. The Hang Seng now sits just above the 24,550-point plateau although it may open under water again on Wednesday.

events.title: China Stock Market May Be Stuck In Neutral On Wednesday
events.description: The China stock market has moved higher in consecutive trading days, gathering more than a dozen points or 0.3 percent along the way. The Shanghai Composite Index now sits just above the 3,660-point plateau although the rally may stall on Wednesday.

events.title: Tech Shares May Weigh On Taiwan Stock Market
events.description: The Taiwan stock market has climbed higher in two straight sessions, accelerating almost 2,000 points or 5 percent in that span. The Taiwan Stock Exchange now sits just above the 42,710-point plateau although it may be stuck in neutral on Wednesday.

events.title: Singapore Stock Market May Remain Rangebound
events.description: The Singapore stock market has finished higher in two of three trading days since the end of the five-day losing streak in which it had slumped almost 130 points or 2.5 percent. The Straits Times Index now sits just beneath the 5,260-point plateau although it may hand back those gains on Wednesday.

events.title: Malaysia Stock Market May Test Support At 1,600 Points
events.description: The Malaysia stock market has alternated between positive and negative finishes through the last four trading days since the end of the three-day winning streak in which it had gathered almost a dozen points or 0.7 percent. The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index now sits just above the 1,600-point plateau and it may extend its losses on Wednesday.

events.title: Rally May Stall For Japan Stock Market
events.description: The Japan stock market has finished higher in back-to-back sessions, advancing more than 3,000 points or 5 percent in that span. The Nikkei 225 now sits just above the 60,450-point plateau although investors may lock in gains on Wednesday.

events.title: KOSPI May See Renewed Consolidation On Wednesday
events.description: The South Korea stock market on Tuesday snapped the three-day losing streak in which it had crashed more than 660 points or 11.8 percent. The KOSPI now sits just beneath the 5,240-point plateau although it may head south again on Wednesday.

events.title: Australia Home Loan Data Due On Wednesday
events.description: Australia will on Wednesday release Q3 figures for home loans, highlighting a light day for Asia-Pacific economic activity. In the three months prior, home loans were down 1.9 percent on quarter.

events.title: U.S. Dollar Advances Amid Rising Fed Rate Hike Expectations Following CPI Release
events.description: The U.S. Dollar value moved higher on Tuesday with heightening expectations of an interest rate hike by the U.S. Federal Reserve following the release of U.S. inflation data which came in exceeding analysts' forecasts. In addition, despite a pause in the U.S. attacks on Iran, the absence of a breakthrough in negotiations kept inflation concerns alive.

events.title: European Markets Finished Mixed On Tuesday
events.description: The major European markets finished mostly higher on Tuesday, although they trended downward throughout the day and ended on opposite sides of the unchanged line.

events.title: FTSE 100 Firm Above The Flatline
events.description: The FTSE 100 benchmark of the London Stock Exchange is trading firmly above the flatline even as global market sentiment suffered following disappointing inflation data from the U.S. The hawkish comments from a Fed official further renewed rate hike expectations, dampening overall market sentiment.

events.title: U.S. Consumer Prices Climb 0.4% In October, More Than Expected
events.description: Consumer prices in the U.S. increased by more than expected in the month of October, according to a closely watched report released by the Labor Department on Tuesday. The Labor Department said its consumer price index rose by 0.4 percent in October after climbing by 0.6 percent in September. Economists had expected consumer prices to rise by 0.3 percent.

events.title: CAC 40 Extends Gains
events.description: The CAC 40 index that tracks the 40 largest French stocks based on the Euronext Paris added to Monday's gains as markets cheered the global rebound in tech shares.
